FN-G3ZHY62-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 300
Committee: Insurance Sponsor: Representative Frances Holk-Jones
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: «Released Date»
House Bill 300 as introduced would require certain health benefit plans that provide coverage
for a supplemental or diagnostic breast examination to not impose any cost-sharing requirements
on enrollees, which could increase the costs of the State Employees' Health Insurance Plan
(SEHIP) and the Public Employees' Health Insurance Plan (PEEHIP) by an undetermined
amount dependent on: (1) if molecular breast imaging is required to be covered, (2) how many
more breast examinations will be required to be covered due to family history, and (3) if the bill
is requiring coverage for out-of-network services.
